lines: I've seen this beach from the water before, but...
It's a lot different being up here.
The sand feels so strange under my feet.

choices.text: Well, I think you look pretty cute standing on it.
Aren't you always burying yourself in the sand?
We can stay closer to the water if you want.

lines: I guess having legs isn't so bad...

1: O-oh, um... thank you.
You still think so?
2: You don't have to say that just to make me feel better...
Sorry. I know you're trying to be nice.
3: Penni... are you serious?
I don't know what to believe right now.

lines: I'm usually in the sand, not standing on it!
And I didn't have feet before...

1: Th-that's different!
Okay... I guess you got me there.
2: I know, but...
I don't really feel like being teased right now.
3: Could you please not make fun of me today?
I just wanted us to have a nice time.

lines: I want to see more of it.

1: Oh... thanks for asking.
I think I want to try a little longer.
2: Would you mind staying close to me?
I think I'd feel better that way.
3: You'd really do that for me?
I... appreciate it, Penni.

lines: I used to see shells like these all the time underwater.
They look so different in the sunlight...
Do people just... take these home?

choices.text: I could keep one to remember our date.
Only the really expensive ones. That one's probably worth a fortune.
Yeah! You should take it home if you like it.

lines: Then... I think I want one too.

1: Oh... for our date?
I hope it's a good memory.
2: You mean you'd want to remember today?
I wasn't sure you would.
3: I don't know why you'd want to remember this...
Sorry. That's not fair to you.

1: W-wait, really?
Oh. You're teasing me again.
2: I can't tell when you're being serious lately.
Sorry, I know it's just a joke.
3: Please don't trick me right now.
I wanted to show you something I liked.

lines: Maybe I'll put it by my window.

1: I think I will...
It'll be nice to have something from today.
2: Maybe I could keep it on my shelf.
So I can remember we did this together.
3: I'd... really like that.
I'd like something to remind me of today.

lines: When I first came up here, I thought I'd just look around for a little while.
I didn't really think I'd end up staying.
And now I've got a house, and all this stuff, and...

choices.text: I'm pretty glad you stayed. It makes taking you on dates a lot easier.
And here I thought you only stayed for the spyglass.
I'm really happy you're here, Silas.

1: Y-yeah. I guess that's one good reason.
I hope it's still a good reason for you.
2: Do you... still want to take me on dates?
I can't really tell anymore.
3: I'm not sure it feels easy anymore.
Sorry... I didn't mean to say that.

lines: Well, the spyglass is pretty great...
But I guess there are some other reasons too.

1: Well, it is a pretty great spyglass!
But... that's not the only reason. You know that, right?
2: It's not just the spyglass...
I wish I knew if you were joking about that.
3: Do you really think that's why I'm here?
Penni, I stayed because of you.

1: Oh...
I'm really happy you still feel that way.
2: You have no idea how much I needed to hear that.
I was starting to worry.
3: Really? Even now?
I... want to believe you.

lines: Can we sit down for a little bit?
I used to watch people sitting on the beach all the time.
I never really understood what they were doing...
But I think I'm starting to get it.

choices.text: You can lean on me if you want.
Look at you. You're becoming a real beach person.
Sometimes it's nice to just sit and do nothing.

1: O-oh...
Okay. Just for a little while?
2: Are you sure?
I'm worried I'll make things awkward.
3: I don't know if I can do that right now.
But... thank you for asking.

lines: That's a little weird to think about.

1: A beach person? Hehe...
Maybe. I'm still getting used to it.
2: I don't know...
I don't feel very good at this today.
3: Can we not joke about me for a minute?
I just want to sit with you.

1: Yeah...
It's easier to relax when you're here.
2: I'd like that.
Can we sit together for a little longer?
3: I really want things to feel like that again.
Could you stay with me a while?

lines: I know it's just the beach, but...
I had a really nice time with you.
Maybe we can come back again sometime?
